<!--
The old page embedded the PDF in a bare <object>/<embed> and nothing else,
which renders as a blank box on mobile Safari and Android Chrome - i.e. the CV
was effectively unavailable to phone visitors, with no download link outside
the fallback text.

Now the download button comes first and always works. The inline preview is
progressive enhancement, hidden under 768px by the .cv-embed rule in
html/theme.scss.
-->

```{=html}
<div class="button-row">
  <a class="btn-download" href="cv.pdf" download>Download CV (PDF)</a>
  <a class="btn-download" href="cv.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener"
     style="background:transparent;color:#8a2b33 !important;">Open in new tab</a>
</div>
```

Last updated May 2026.

```{=html}
<object class="cv-embed" data="cv.pdf" type="application/pdf">
  <p>Your browser cannot display PDFs inline.
     <a href="cv.pdf">Download the PDF</a> instead.</p>
</object>
```
